# Kod Sınağı · Code Check

> A free bilingual (Azerbaijani / English) quiz on web development basics: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Each round has 10 random questions from a bank of 20 per category, 20 seconds per question, keyboard shortcuts 1-4, and a review of the missed answers at the end. Best scores are kept in the browser.

Built by codelady-ship with React and Vite. An optional Express + MongoDB API adds an online question bank and a leaderboard; without it the bundled questions are used.

## Key pages

- [Quiz (start screen, AZ/EN switch)](https://codelady-ship.github.io/My-Quiz-App/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/codelady-ship/My-Quiz-App)

## Categories

- HTML (20 questions)
- CSS (20 questions)
- JavaScript (20 questions)
- React (20 questions)

Every question and answer option exists in both Azerbaijani and English.

## Notes

- Single-page app: there are no separate URLs per question or per language; the language switch changes the page text, <html lang>, title and description.
- No sign-up, no ads, free to use.
